description: Returns priced options with delivery dates once the order is fully described and the artwork has passed the print check. Present them to the customer; each has an id for choose_option. In clients that render our checkout summary the customer can continue to checkout there, and you will see that as a message. Call it again whenever the customer asks to see or reconsider the options; it costs nothing. Prices come from us and cannot be passed in.
name: get_options

alternatives.description: Present from the moment several styles fit until the customer picks, beside whatever ask_next asks: show all of them with their summaries, prices and minimums, say the one marked is_provisional is what we will use unless they choose, and call choose_style with the id they pick (or send "any" to describe_order to leave it to us).

cut.description: How it hangs: loose, standard or fitted, in customer words.

id.description: Pass this to choose_style when the customer picks it.

is_provisional.description: True on the style we will use unless the customer picks another.

minimum.description: The minimum as the storefront words it ("Minimum 10", "No minimum"). Say it with the price.

minimum_quantity.description: The fewest pieces the style is sold in.

mockup_url.description: An image address: show it as a picture where your client can, unless our app already shows it in the chat, never as text or as a link, and never describe it in place of the summary.

price_label.description: "cheapest" or "priciest" of the three, when they differ.

priced_at_quantity.description: The quantity the price is for: the order's, or 1 until the customer says how many, or the style's minimum when that is more. It drops at 12 and again at 24.

summary.description: One line on what sets it apart. Relay it as written.

unit_price_cents.description: Garment and printing, per garment, at priced_at_quantity.

weight.description: Lightweight, midweight or heavyweight, in customer words.

findings.description: What we measured: the crisp width, the background, the file.

max_print_width_in.description: Largest width, in inches, that prints crisply.

review_notes.description: What our design reviewer said about this file on this garment: the background, which garment colors suit it, fine detail. Relay it when the customer asks about color or the design, or has not heard it yet; it was shown on the upload page but you did not see it.

suggested_colors.description: The garment colors this design suits among those the customer can still choose, best first, scored from the design's own colors: shades once a garment is named, color families before. They lead the color choices. Empty once the color is decided.

artwork_upload_url.description: Present until the design is accepted. Show it to the customer as one link labeled "Upload your design", not as a bare address: they drop their design file on that page and it is checked there. You cannot upload for them.

ask_next.description: Ask the customer this, in your own words, and send the answer to describe_order.

checkout_url.description: Show it to the customer as one link labeled "Pay and enter shipping", not as a bare address: they see the artwork and total, confirm their email with a code we send them, then pay and enter their address there.

choices.description: Answers the customer can pick from, one set per field ask_next asks about. Offer them as selectable options where your client can, otherwise as a short list. They are suggestions: colors are families and the customer may name any shade, quantity and width may be any number. Send whatever they answer to describe_order.

delivers_by.description: The date free delivery arrives, YYYY-MM-DD.

delivery_days.description: Business days from now to the customer's door with free delivery.

meets_deadline.description: Whether free delivery arrives by the customer's deadline.

rush_delivers_by.description: The earliest date rush delivery arrives, YYYY-MM-DD; its shipping is priced at checkout, where the customer chooses the speed.

rush_delivery_days.description: Business days to the door with rush delivery; null when rush is no sooner.

expires_at.description: When an unsaved order expires; null once it is saved to an account or paid.

garment.description: The garment on the order, and what mockup_url shows. Name it when you show the picture; when it is provisional, say so.

color.description: The shade on the order, as the mill names it.

fabric.description: The fabric family in customer words.

is_provisional.description: True while alternatives are on offer and the customer has not picked: this is the garment we will use unless they choose another.

materials.description: The mill's own material words, e.g. "Tri-Blend (Poly/Cotton/Rayon)".

size.description: The size, or the size spread in the style's size order: "2 S, 6 M, 7 L". Sizes alone until their pieces are known.

mockup_changed.description: True when mockup_views shows the design on the garment differently from the last time it was shown: a new garment, color, design, placement or width. Show the pictures again when it is true.

mockup_url.description: The garment on the order, in the customer's color, with their design on it once we have it. An image address: show it as a picture where your client can, unless our app already shows it in the chat, never as text or as a link, and never describe it in place of the summary.

mockup_views.description: Every side of the garment, the printed one first: mockup_url with the design, then the other sides plain. Where your client can show pictures, show them all, so the customer sees which sides stay blank.

label.description: The side, in customer words: Front, Back, Side.

printed.description: True on the side the design goes on; the others are plain and stay blank.

url.description: An image address: show it as a picture where your client can, unless our app already shows it in the chat, never as text or as a link, and never describe it in place of the summary.

next_call.description: What to call next, and why.

delivers_by.description: The date free delivery arrives, YYYY-MM-DD.

delivery_days.description: Business days from now to the customer's door with free delivery.

meets_deadline.description: Whether free delivery arrives by the customer's deadline.

rush_delivers_by.description: The earliest date rush delivery arrives, YYYY-MM-DD; its shipping is priced at checkout, where the customer chooses the speed.

rush_delivery_days.description: Business days to the door with rush delivery; null when rush is no sooner.

saved.description: Whether the order is saved to a customer account (save_progress).

spec.description: The print as the customer has described it so far, beside garment. Null where they have not said; still_needed lists what is missing.

color.description: The shade in the customer's words.

cut.description: The fit they asked for, in customer words, when they volunteered one; it narrows the garments offered.

garment_type.description: The garment in the customer's words, before a product has been settled on.

placement.description: Where the print goes, in customer words.

size.description: The one size the order is in; null until a size is known, and when the order is spread across several.

sizes.description: The size spread: how the quantity splits across sizes. Complete once the pieces add up to quantity; get_options needs it complete.

quantity.description: Pieces in this size; null until the customer says how many.

weight.description: The fabric weight they asked for, in customer words, when they volunteered one; it narrows the garments offered.

still_needed.description: Fields the customer has not told us yet, and any go-ahead we are waiting on for something the order cannot carry.

title: Get priced options
